reviewer_notes: The full Arabic Companies Law text and the scanned PDF packet were owner-provided from the official Bureau of Experts at the Council of Ministers source and together form the controlling source packet for the workflow (see boe_source_provenance below). The text was ingested and segmented into 281 article records (each with a SHA-256 of its verbatim official_text_ar). Source-provenance confidence is separated from article-by-article automated verification: the repository has NOT performed a direct automated article-by-article verification against live BOE HTML (direct automated capture was blocked or unsuitable), so article_by_article_verified stays false and articles_verified stays 0. The enum fields official_arabic_text_status=user_provided_source_ingested and verification_status=ingested_unverified describe the ingestion / automated-verification axis ONLY and must not be read as doubting the source provenance. OCR artifacts are supporting evidence only, not the source-confidence gate; no legal text was changed and no article was promoted by OCR. Arabic remains governing; current Arabic summaries remain secondary / non-official.
